applicabilityBasis.summary: IDRT is marketed as a 1:1 Indonesian-rupiah stablecoin with payment/transfer and withdrawal functionality. Its still-published December 2019 whitepaper expressly disclaims any contractual buyback obligation or indebtedness to holders, while current FAQs describe bank-account redemption. The issuer obligation element of the GENIUS payment-stablecoin definition is therefore unresolved from the opened disclosures.

genius.notes: Evidence reviewed 2026-10-07: PT Rupiah Token Indonesia is an Indonesian issuer; its domicile and cash/AUP reserves do not establish U.S. GENIUS authorization or a foreign exception. Current FAQs describe rupiah conversion and redemption, but the December 2019 whitepaper disclaims a contractual buyback obligation, so applicability is conservatively unclear rather than a formal payment-stablecoin determination. No token-specific public GENIUS approval, state qualification, official application, registration or issuer-announced GENIUS intent was located in the checked sources. The August 31 reserve AUP, signed September 29, explicitly provides no audit/review opinion or assurance; monthlyAttestationPresent remains false. Federal substantive rules remain proposed and not-yet-restricted describes the GENIUS timeline, not an absence of venue restrictions. The March 31 historical AUP is retained with its actual April 13 report date.

sourcesChecked: OCC Bulletin 2026-3, reopened 2026-10-07: proposed issuer and foreign-registration framework, not a token approval.

OCC Digital Assets Licensing Applications, direct HTTPS/HTML table extraction on 2026-10-07: nine pending charter applicants, none matching this token or identified issuer; this table is not an exhaustive GENIUS register.
Treasury August 17 section 3 proposal (sb0605), reopened 2026-10-07: expected January 18, 2027 effectiveness and separate DASP implementation dates.
September 30 SCRC procedural interim final rule, reopened 2026-10-07: procedures do not certify a state regime or qualify this issuer.
Federal Reserve September 24 proposals and Public Law 119-27, reopened 2026-10-07: functional payment-stablecoin definition and proposed implementation.

Public search on 2026-10-07 for IDRT, IDRX, EJPY and GMO-Z.com Trust with GENIUS, PPSI, enforcement or registration across OCC, Treasury, NYDFS, FDIC, NCUA, Federal Reserve, SEC, CFTC and FinCEN domains. No exact token-specific GENIUS approval, application, registration or enforcement result located; unrelated biotechnology IDRx results excluded.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, no token-specific U.S. GENIUS PPSI approval, state qualification, official application, registered foreign exception or issuer-announced GENIUS intent was found for IDRT or PT Rupiah Token Indonesia in the opened regulator and issuer disclosures. Applicability is separately unclear because the published whitepaper disclaims a contractual buyback obligation; this negative authorization review does not resolve that legal issue.
